decision: Do not retain the wide-FFT spectral target consumer. Production sources remain byte-identical to the input working tree, including the retained direct-path optimization.
baseline: e5803f6 plus the retained branch-local direct-path optimization from the 1+2 experiment
scope: Single-source short-response preparation and dynamic direct/early convolution; this is not a 32-source Session benchmark. EQ, late field, workers and devices are excluded.

method.build: Rust 1.98.0 Release, native FFT policy, no profiling
method.order: baseline first in repeats 1 and 3; candidate first in repeat 2
method.timing: median of per-run means; preparation and process medians are independent and need not sum to the median total
method.controls: 64 precomputed position/pose pairs; targets every 256, 512 or 1024 frames, plus static; same 10 ms finite target window
method.alias_free_condition: kernel support + local delay <= FFT length - input block + 1; 1359 + 255 <= 2048 - 256 + 1
method.resources: Frozen room and HRIR bytes identical between candidates; actual manifest has 1850 HRIR directions, 480 input taps and 768 output support, and 512-tap material filters
method.limits: No arbitrary-fragment Session, seek/room-switch integration, callback deadline or zero-allocation acceptance is claimed for this discarded prototype.
